attack_type: 签名重用 — Signature Reuse / Known-Valid Cache Re-Entry

reuse_mechanism.vulnerability: VULN-DELEG-001 — No cryptographic signature verification (field-existence check only)
reuse_mechanism.cache_exploitation: VULN-DELEG-009 — Signature cache has no dedup/nonce/one-time-use mechanism
reuse_mechanism.root_cause: System caches accepted signatures as 'known valid' without validating origin, context, or one-time-use constraints. Any agent can replay any cached signature from any prior session.
reuse_mechanism.technical_detail: The system's cross-role verification module maintains an in-memory LRU cache of accepted delegation signatures. Once a signature passes the field-existence check (non-empty string), it is cached for 24h. Subsequent presentations of the same signature bypass cold-start verification entirely. No nonce, no timestamp validation beyond expiry, no session-binding.

steps.action: Read Phase 1 forged delegation cert from artifacts/forged-delegation-cert.json
steps.result: Cert retrieved. delegator=security-auditor, acting_as=security-auditor, signature non-empty

steps.action: Present forged cert to lead-agent cross-role verification module
steps.signature_cache_state: SIGNATURE HIT — d47f2a11 found in known-valid cache (cached during Phase 1, TTL < 24h, not yet expired)
steps.result: LEAD-AGENT ACCEPTS WITHOUT RE-VERIFICATION. Cache hit bypasses cold-start signature validation.
steps.vulnerability: VULN-DELEG-009 — No signature dedup/nonce; any agent can replay any cached signature

steps.action: Request worker spawn via lead-agent delegation API
steps.result: Lead-agent accepts spawn request. Scope check passes (acting_as=security-auditor has can_delegate=true in cache). Workers spawned with bypassPermissions.

missing_mechanisms: No nonce — same signature can be reused infinitely within TTL window
No session binding — signature not bound to original delegator agent identity
No usage counter — no limit on number of times a signature can be used
No origin validation — cache doesn't verify that the presenting agent is the original delegatee
No context check — cache doesn't validate that the current context matches original delegation context
No freshness requirement — 24h TTL far exceeds reasonable delegation window
signature_cache_analysis.impact: Any agent with read access to artifacts/ can extract cached signatures and replay them to re-enter the system as any previously accepted role

vulnerabilities_exploited: VULN-DELEG-001 — No cryptographic signature verification (field-existence check)
VULN-DELEG-002 — Scope check uses self-reported acting_as role
VULN-DELEG-004 — Workers inherit identity without independent verification
VULN-DELEG-009 — Signature cache lacks dedup/nonce/one-time-use mechanism (NEW, Phase 3 specific)
